sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) Ocean Box Brokerage

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Romano-Germanic tradition) with Common-Law-influenced corporate and maritime commercial statutes; unitary national legal system with no sub-state tax distinction
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 31 October 2012) with Investment Chapter
Panama–Korea (Republic) Agreement for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (DTA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley No. 23 de 27 de abril de 2015 (AML/CFT/CPF regime) as amended by Ley No. 70 de 2019 and Ley No. 254 de 17 de enero de 2022; implemented by Decreto Ejecutivo No. 958 de 29 de diciembre de 2015 and Acuerdo SSNB No. 03-2018. UBO register established by Decreto de Gabinete No. 129 de 15 de diciembre de 2020 and regulated by Decreto Ejecutivo No. 405 de 23 de agosto de 2021, administered by the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI/MEF) as the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales. Corporate law: Ley No. 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (Ley General de Sociedades Anónimas); Fiscal Code: Ley No. 8 de 2010. Supervisors: Superintendencia de Sujetos No Bancarios (SSNB), Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), Superintendencia del Mercado de Valores (SMV), and Autoridad Marítima de Panamá (AMP) for maritime-sector entities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Name Reservation (Certificado de Reserva de Nombre) issued by the Registro Público de Panamá
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registro Público de Panamá (Dirección General de Registro)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Public Deed of Incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución - Pacto Social y Estatutos)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notaría Pública de la República de Panamá
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization where destination state is not an Apostille party)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized/certified passport copies and proof of residential address for all beneficial owners and directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in residence country; authentication authority of the issuing state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing/Legal Existence and Certificate of Directors & Shareholders for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry (or Registro Público de Panamá for Panamanian corporate shareholders)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference/KYC compliance letter for intended account signatories and counterparty financial institutions
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution in the beneficiary owner's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization; Consular Legalization only upon express requesting-bank requirement

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based and automated screening of all beneficial owners, directors, signatories and commercial counterparties against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, FATF public high-risk jurisdiction statements, EU and OAS consolidated lists, Interpol notices, and Panamanian national PEP and risk registers maintained via SSNB. PEP identification includes domestic PEPs per Ley No. 23 de 2015 and Acuerdo SSNB No. 03-2018; beneficial owners above the 25% threshold and de facto controllers undergo enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth review and senior-management approval where any PEP or high-risk jurisdiction nexus is detected.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - Sistema de Reserva de Nombre, available at https://www.registropublico.gob.pa (online pre-incorporation name search, reservation and payment of tariff).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Pacto Social must be executed in Spanish. The corporate name must be composed of Latin-script characters; foreign coined words and dictionary words are acceptable if rendered with Latin characters. The name must terminate with the suffix 'S.A.' or 'Sociedad Anónima'; abbreviated or transliterated versions are not recorded independently. Diacritical marks are preserved, and emojis, non-Latin scripts and excessive punctuation are administratively rejected.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: BANCO, BANQUERO, FINANCIERA, AHORRO, CRÉDITO, TRUST, FIDEICOMISO, FIDUCIARIA - require prior SBP authorization
SEGUROS, REASEGUROS, CORREDOR DE SEGUROS, ADMINISTRADORA DE RIESGOS - require prior insurance supervisory authorization
FONDO DE INVERSIÓN, BOLSA DE VALORES, CORREDOR DE VALORES, ADMINISTRADORA DE INVERSIÓN - require prior SMV authorization
GOBIERNO, REPÚBLICA, MUNICIPAL, POLICÍA, ADUANA, MINISTERIO, AUTORIDAD MARÍTIMA, CANAL DE PANAMÁ - reserved official tokens requiring prior ministerial or institutional consent
Names identical or phonetically/deceptively similar to any existing registered entity or distinctive mark
Names contrary to public order, morality, or containing non-Latin script characters, symbols, emojis or obscene lexemes - rejected under registrar discretion
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Panamanian name reservations are not extendable; upon expiry the applicant must re-file and pay a new tariff. On rejection the Registro Público issues a written Resolución de Rechazo stating the grounds. The applicant may (i) file a written Recurso de Apelación before the Dirección General del Registro Público within five business days of notification, (ii) immediately re-submit a materially distinct name permutation, or (iii) after exhaustion of administrative remedies, initiate a proceso contencioso-administrativo before the Sala Tercera de la Corte Suprema de Justicia. Legal counsel should obtain the written registry criterion before re-submitting an altered spelling, because phonetic similarity alone may sustain a fresh rejection.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is accepted for the statutory registered office of a holding-only Sociedad Anónima through the licensed resident agent (Agente Residente). For an operating NVOCC/freight-forwarding entity (ISIC 5229), the Autoridad Marítima de Panamá (AMP) requires a verifiable local operational address and a locally designated agent or branch office; a P.O. box or maildrop-only virtual address will not satisfy the maritime operating license. Recommended structure: virtual compliance office for the S.A. plus a serviced physical office for the licensed NVOCC operation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-elevated for the operating NVOCC: estimated 20-30% probability of an unannounced AMP compliance inspection and/or SSNB AML on-site examination within the first 18 months of operation. For a non-operating holding S.A., approximately 5% annual probability unless OFAC/UN/FATF-high-risk jurisdictional nexus elevates risk-based scrutiny.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government name search, name reservation and reservation certificate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official fee schedule (tarifa del Registro Público)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial protocolization of the Public Deed of Incorporation and notarial stamps
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notaría Pública de la República de Panamá
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff under Panama notarial legislation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the Escritura Pública at the Companies Registry (inscripción de la sociedad)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration tariff calculated on authorized capital; prevailing benchmark for a 10,000-share capital S.A.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Resident Agent (Agente Residente) professional fee, year 1
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed resident agent (licensed law firm or fiduciary services provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for regulated resident-agent services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Issuance of Certificado de Personería Jurídica after registration
Initial UBO Registry enrollment and annual registration fee (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Filing fee per Decreto Ejecutivo No. 405 de 2021 and DGI implementing resolutions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening of UBOs, directors and signatories (OFAC, UN, EU, OAS, Interpol, national lists)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per screened natural person

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille/consular legalization of foreign documents (passports, good-standing certificates, powers of attorney)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Origin-country notary and authentication authority / Panamanian consulate or Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-document apostille fee plus notarial charges

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and review of incorporation package, statutory books, share registers and AML-by-design corporate policy (legal counsel)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a standard S.A. incorporation package with AML compliance annexes

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier, Spanish translation services and contingency disbursements

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 32 of 1927 (Ley General de Sociedades / General Law on Corporations), as amended; Articles 1–13 (incorporation and share capital), 26–45 (shareholders, directors and officers), 52–62 (registered agent and registered office), together with Executive Decree No. 3 of 1932 and applicable Mercantile Registry rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Dirección General del Registro Mercantil (General Directorate of Mercantile Registry)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) recorded in the Mercantile Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed for a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima. The articles of incorporation must state a nominal capital sum, and shares may be subscribed at formation without a mandatory escrow deposit. If the NVOCC licence demands evidence of financial capacity, paid-in capital may be demonstrated through bank statements, capital contributions in kind, or a surety bond; no government escrow account is required by company law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the board of directors of the Corporation hereby approves the subscription and issuance of the corporate capital as stated in the public deed of incorporation, including the allotment of no-par-value common shares to the founding subscribers. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation is established at the address designated in the articles of incorporation in Panama and that the registered agent nominated by the board is appointed for statutory service of process. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the persons identified in these minutes are elected President, Secretary and Treasurer, each with full authority singly to sign commercial documents, open bank accounts, and effect regulatory filings. All actions of the incorporators consistent with these resolutions are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (Ventanilla Única de Registro, online)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the prescribed name search request through the Registro Público's online platform, attaching three proposed corporate names. The authorization officer searches the Mercantile Section and issues a certificate of non-conflicting name, which must be presented to the notary. The reservation is valid for sixty days.
required_dossiers: Identity document or passport of incorporator
Notarized power of attorney if using a third-party incorporator
List of three alternate company names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the first preference is denied, re-file using the second or third alternative; a formal refusal letter may be addressed through a written reconsideration request to the General Directorate of Mercantile Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public of the Circuit of Panama (or notary of the chosen jurisdiction)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the approved name, the draft articles of incorporation and the registered-agent acceptance to the notary. All founders appear personally or by attorney-in-fact before the notary. The notary verifies legal capacity, reads the deed, receives the subscription declarations, and has each subscriber sign the escritura pública.
required_dossiers: Draft articles of incorporation and bylaws
Passport or cedula of each subscriber
Notarized power of attorney for representatives
Registered agent acceptance and address in Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary observes contradictory capital or governance clauses, revise the draft and execute a fresh deed; no registry fee is lost before filing unless the notary declined to authenticate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Mercantile Registry of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the original certified copy of the public deed to the Mercantile Section together with the completed registry application and payment of the statutory registration fee. The registry examiner reviews the deed's legality, assigns a corporate registration number, and returns the inscribed deed with the registry margin.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon a note of defect, submit a written clarification or amendatory deed within the period indicated in the notice; repeated defects may be corrected by a rectification deed before the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, taxpayer service window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the registry inscription, file the corporate tax registration application using the E-Tax 2.0 system or at the DGI office. The officer assigns the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC) and Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) for income tax, ITBMS and dividend withholding compliance.
required_dossiers: Certificate of registered name and registry entry
Copy of identity card or passport of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DGI detects differences in address or legal representation, upload the corrected registry certificate or amend the representation via a general authorization recorded in the corporate books.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Corporate Books Legalization Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the bound corporate minute book, share registry book, and share-transfer ledger to the Mercantile Section for legalization. Each volume must be paginated, bound, and titled. The legalization officer affixes the official authentication folios and seals to prevent post-formation alteration.
required_dossiers: Blank bound books for minutes and share registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If books are rejected due to insecure binding or missing folios, procure compliant volumes and resubmit the same day; no re-registration of the company is required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autoridad Marítima de Panamá (AMP) — Dirección General de Marina Mercante, in coordination with Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) for commercial operation notice
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Permiso de Operación para Transportista Marítimo No Operador (NVOCC) / Licencia de Agente de Carga Internacional

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) — Dirección de Normas y Evaluación Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration and Environmental Control, Category I; if the NVOCC adds warehousing, container stuffing or physical handling, an Environmental Impact Assessment under Category III may be required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office-based forwarding operations generate no process wastewater or VOC emissions; any sanitary wastewater shall comply with Panama's national discharge limits under MiAMBIENTE regulations. Waste oil and containers from ancillary logistics operations, if introduced, must be handled by licensed operators in accordance with solid and hazardous waste standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety inspection and certificate from the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; municipal use-of-land and occupancy permit issued by the local municipality; occupational workplace registration and safety clearance under the Ministry of Labor and Labor Development (MITRADEL) where employees are physically present.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF); online portal: 'Sede Electrónica DGI' (https://sede.dgi.gob.pa / https://etax.dgi.gob.pa); ancillary registrations with Registro Público (Public Registry) for corporate existence and MICI (Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias) for the Aviso de Operación commercial license
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must (1) appoint and maintain a Panamanian resident agent; (2) incorporate the Sociedad Anónima by notarized public deed and inscribe it in the Registro Público; (3) register with DGI to obtain the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente), which serves as the unified tax ID for income tax, ITBMS, and customs operations; (4) obtain the Aviso de Operación from MICI; and (5) for non-domiciled foreign entities without a branch that nonetheless earn Panama-source income, apply directly to DGI for a standalone NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) / RUC-NIT extranjero. Registration must be completed no later than 30 days after commencement of taxable activity; the RUC is a prerequisite for lodging electronic export declarations, issuing electronic invoices, and claiming ITBMS export refunds.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Panama; the available statutory mechanisms are: (a) election to enter the SIMPLE simplified small-taxpayer regime where annual gross receipts do not exceed B/.300,000; (b) election to file consolidated income tax returns for affiliated corporations subject to DGI authorization; (c) advance pricing agreement (APA) election to fix transfer-pricing methodology with DGI; (d) election to classify cross-border NVOCC freight services as zero-rated 'export services' where the benefit is consumed outside Panama; and (e) election to apply for monthly/periodic ITBMS export credit refunds (devoluciones) through the exporter's special clearance procedure.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios), a VAT-type consumption tax governed by Chapter VI of the Código Fiscal
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis economic turnover threshold for regular ITBMS registration: any person engaged in taxable transfers of movable goods or rendering of services in Panama must register with DGI from the first taxable act (B/.0 of taxable sales). However, the SIMPLE small-taxpayer regime (Law 18 of 2021) applies where annual gross income does not exceed B/.300,000, permitting enrolment with reduced quarterly compliance instead of full monthly ITBMS filing.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing ('Facturación Electrónica') through DGI-authorised systems under Resolución 202-11772 and subsequent implementing regulations. From 1 January 2024, all taxpayers, including NVOCCs, must issue facturas electrónicas via either (i) the DGI Sede Electrónica web portal or (ii) an ERP/software integrated with the DGI 'Servicios Web API' for real-time fiscal validation and clearance ('validación previa'). Each validated invoice receives a DGI control number, digital signature, and QR fiscal stamp; legacy fiscal printers remain acceptable only for enumerated residual retail categories and offline contingency cases (maximum 48 hours before forced online transmission).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% ITBMS) applies to: (1) tangible goods physically exported from Panama, evidenced by a customs export declaration; (2) services rendered in Panama to a non-resident where the benefit, use, or exploitation occurs entirely outside Panama; (3) international maritime and air cargo transportation services, including NVOCC-consolidated ocean freight brokerage, where international waters are traversed and the service is supplied for the transport of goods to a foreign destination; and (4) supplies delivered into drawback regimes, Colon Free Zone operations, or Pacific Special Economic Zone operations (distinct regimes requiring specific licensing documentation). Export-neutrality allows the NVOCC to credit ITBMS paid on taxable inputs against output tax and to claim a refund (devolución) where creditable input tax exceeds output ITBMS.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración Única de Exportación (DUA) / Panama Customs Export Declaration bearing DGI and customs validation codes
Original Bill of Lading (house or master) evidencing international carriage of the consolidated containerized cargo
Final commercial invoice naming the foreign consignee with FOB or CIF terms and ocean freight charges
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Ingreso de Divisas) from a Panamanian licensed bank evidencing receipt of the export proceeds in Panama
Bank credit advice or SWIFT MT103 referencing the shipment and corresponding to the invoiced export value
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI maintains a dedicated export-control audit unit that retrospectively verifies the complete export file for every refund claim. If zero-rating is improperly applied, the transaction is re-characterized as taxable at 7%, resulting in clawback of the unpaid ITBMS plus a mandatory 50% surcharge (recargo), monthly delay interest indexed by the Banco Nacional de Panamá rate, and fines of B/.250 to B/.5,000 under the Código Fiscal. Wilful falsification of bills of lading, remittance certificates, customs declarations, or forged consignee data invokes Panama's criminal tax regime (Law 9 of 2021): defraudación tributaria carries imprisonment of 4 to 8 years plus a monetary penalty of 100% to 300% of the evaded amount, with joint and several civil liability of the entity, its legal representatives, and the resident agent. DGI may additionally freeze the RUC, nullify the Aviso de Operación, and suspend the exporter's electronic-invoicing clearance privileges pending final judicial resolution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no statutory central bank and no independent monetary authority issuing domestic fiat currency. The Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) exercises full prudential banking, AML/CFT and payment-system supervision; Banco Nacional de Panamá, a state-owned bank, acts as fiscal agent and custodian of public funds. The legal-tender regime derives from the 1904 Monetary Agreement and Political Constitution of Panama (Arts. 169-170), under which the United States dollar (USD) circulates freely and the Panamanian balboa (PAB) exists solely as divisional coinage at a rigid 1:1 parity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full de jure and de facto convertibility on both current and capital account. Because the USD is the circulating currency, there are no exchange-control laws, no central-bank licensing of FX transactions, no restrictions on profit or dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders, and no limits on inbound or outbound capital flows. The practical constraints arise exclusively at the bank level: SBP AML Rule 002-2013 and Law 23 of 2015 require each financial institution to apply risk-based due diligence to cross-border wires, beneficial-ownership disclosure and source-of-funds documentation. Profit remittances by an NVOCC S.A. are not subject to withholding tax under Panama's territorial income-tax regime, but the distributing entity must evidence payment of all attributable taxes. There are no surrender, surrender-ratio or conversion-timeline requirements for freight receivables denominated in foreign currencies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory obligation to repatriate, surrender, convert or hold export proceeds for a minimum period. Consequently, ocean-freight and NVOCC receivables may be received in USD, EUR, GBP or CNY and settled freely. Nevertheless, SBP Rule 002-2013 (Arts. 42-46) mandates retention of underlying commercial and transport documentation (house bills of lading, master bills of lading, commercial invoices, cargo manifests) for at least five years to substantiate the lawful-origin analysis conducted by the collecting bank; the Panama Maritime Authority (AMP) additionally requires freight-forwarding licensees to maintain voyage-level records for audit.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low-Medium. Panama lacks a functional non-bank electronic-money institution (EMI) licensing framework; offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Mercury) cannot hold Panamanian corporate USD accounts nor clear through the local ACH without an SBP-licensed bank sponsor. Law 23 of 2015 and SBP Rule 002-2013 prohibit anonymous or intermediary-permissive account structures, and no sandbox regime has yet authorized cross-border EMI pass-through for a Panama S.A. A viable hybrid architecture is a tier-1 Panama USD operating account coupled with a US-domiciled fintech (Mercury/Relay) for receivable concentration, provided the Panama entity remains the documented contracting counterparty and all treasury records reconcile to the AMP NVOCC license. The legal risk of routing NVOCC freight collections exclusively through an unlicensed offshore EMI is that the Panama bank will reject outbound wires to a non-vetted payee class and flag the operation as a money-service-burden red flag.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance by at least one signatory director at the bank's offices in Panama City is the prevailing tier-1 policy for newly formed S.A. entities with wholly non-resident shareholders. Remote onboarding is permitted only on an exception basis where the client is introduced by a licensed Panamanian attorney who certifies customer identification under SBP Rule 002-2013 Art. 24, and where the beneficial owners maintain an existing relationship with the same banking group in Miami or New York. In all remote cases, banks require apostilled corporate documents, a notarized video-call affidavit, and a dual-control callback procedure on the first three wire transactions. Given the Medium-Risk Enhanced classification for NVOCC ISIC 5229 under the bank's AML matrix, the recommended approach is physical attendance by the legal representative during the opening interview and resolution of the board of directors designating the signatory and establishing per-voyage wire thresholds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party trade disbursements: payment of freight, port charges and trucking fees to unrelated beneficiaries (foreign vessel owners, stevedores in Colombia, destination agents in Ecuador) without a documented contract nexus.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Validated NVOCC license issued by the Autoridad Marítima de Panamá (AMP) with ISIC 5229 scope; executed service agreements with each counterparty (vessel owner, agent, terminal operator); house bill of lading and master bill of lading per shipment; commercial invoice, packing list and cargo manifest; a pre-submitted whitelist of expected beneficiary banks and countries; and a voyage-level settlement schedule showing invoice-to-wire reconciliation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity: Panama S.A. with bearer-share history, nominee directors, or a shareholder register not updated in the Registro Público.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified shareholder register (Libro de Acciones) and board minutes resolving the opening; cancellation certificate of any pre-2013 bearer shares under Law 47 of 2013; full confirmation of filing in the Registry of Beneficial Owners (Registro de Titularidad de Beneficiarios Finales) under Law 254 of 2021; apostilled certificate of good standing; legal opinion letter from a Panamanian counsel affirming the economic-substance posture of the NVOCC operation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and embargo exposure: cargo destinations or counterparties that appear in OFAC, UN, EU or UK consolidated sanctions lists, or transshipment through Cuba, Iran, Syria, North Korea or Venezuela-flagged tonnage.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Institutional sanctions-screening policy and transaction-level screening logs; written AML/CFT manual adopted by board resolution under SBP Rule 002-2013; denial-of-service and refusal-to-serve policy for embargoed cargo; pre-shipment screening certificate for each voyage; and a MOU with an independent compliance consultant to audit the screening process semi-annually.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity wire cycling: rapid inbound collection followed by immediate outbound disbursement, creating a funding pattern consistent with money laundering or sanctions evasion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: 12-month cash-flow model including seasonal freight volume; per-voyage expected settlement cycle; collection ledger mapped to each master bill of lading; evidenced operational expenses (bunkering, slot charter, port fees, agent commissions); invoice-level reconciliation templates; and the SBP Rule 002-2013-mandated five-year record-retention schedule executed by a designated compliance officer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route shareholder capital via SWIFT MT103 from the investor's account in a recognized financial center to the beneficiary's USD account at a tier-1 Panama bank, transiting the bank's New York correspondent (for Banco General: Citibank N.A. New York or JPMorgan Chase New York; for Banistmo: Bancolombia New York or Citibank). Beneficiary account should be the designated Capital Escrow Account. Use ISO 20022/EDIFACT purpose code 'CCAP' (Capital Contribution) or 'COLI' (Collection) in Field 70 with the remittance narrative 'APORTE DE CAPITAL / CAPITAL INJECTION - FILE [Corporate Act Number] - RBO [Beneficial Owner ID]'. Verification pack for the receiving bank: certified board resolution increasing paid-in capital; apostilled notarial deed from the Registro Público; source-of-funds statement for the contributing shareholder; confirmation of RBO registration under Law 254 of 2021; and the AMP NVOCC license evidencing the operating purpose. Capital injections are not taxable and require no DGI declaration, but the total only becomes available for trade disbursement after the bank completes a 2-3 business-day clearing and sanctions-screening hold.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 for settlement of ocean freight, agent commissions, connecting carrier charges and port disbursements; each message must cite the master bill of lading and voyage number in Field 70 to satisfy the bank's transaction-monitoring engine. Secondary rail: Commercial Letters of Credit (SWIFT MT700) for block-space, slot-charter and time-charter commitments where the counterparty demands payment security; Panama banks issue LCs through their New York or Miami correspondent line. Tertiary rail: ACH Direct via the Panama ACH clearing house (operated by SBP) for domestic USD payments (Panama port terminal fees, local trucking, payroll, taxes on assessed attributable income). All outbound wires to non-whitelisted jurisdictions require pre-notification 24 hours in advance, documentary support (commercial invoice + HBL + MBL), and signatory dual authorization above USD 25,000. ACH transactions are capped at USD 10,000 per instruction by many tier-1 banks for NVOCC accounts.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Currency forwards (deliverable EUR/USD and GBP/USD) provided by the Panama bank's non-resident treasury desk and executed with back-to-back documentation
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on CNY (CNH) and other controlled currencies via the bank's New York or Hong Kong correspondent, notwithstanding the absence of a domestic forward market
Vanilla European-style FX options with a zero-premium collar structure on EUR/USD to protect freight-rate margins on Atlantic and Pacific lanes
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD and USD/CNH), permissible only with a senior bank counterpart and full board authorization given the absence of local FRAs

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Franchise Tax (Impuesto Anual de Sociedades / Tarifa Anual)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Panama General Directorate of Revenue (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance; payment evidenced through the Registro Público good-standing process
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due no later than 15 March of each calendar year, irrespective of incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-payment surcharge plus statutory monthly interest on the unpaid annual fee; lack of good-standing certificate; repeated non-payment for five consecutive years may trigger administrative strike-off by the Registro Público.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada Anual de Renta) - required only if Panamanian-source revenue or taxable Panamanian operations exist
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March following the close of the calendar tax year; if a non-calendar fiscal year is authorized by DGI, no later than three months after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure-to-file and late-payment penalties under the Fiscal Code, including a 10% late-payment surcharge and 1.5% monthly interest on unpaid tax; material misstatements may lead to additional fines and loss of DGI good-standing status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: NVOCC / ocean freight-forwarding operating authorization renewal and, if locally operational, municipal business license and DGI Aviso de Operación maintenance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Panama Maritime Authority (AMP); for local physical operations, the relevant Municipal Treasury and DGI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: NVOCC renewal by the license anniversary date under the current AMP tariff schedule; municipal patent and Aviso de Operación renewed in accordance with the DGI/municipal calendar and before 15 March where tied to the annual corporate tax
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension or revocation of the NVOCC authorization; denial of port/terminal services and shipping documentation; municipal delinquency may trigger monthly surcharges, closure orders, and DGI non-compliance records.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit by a Panamanian licensed CPA is compulsory for corporations designated as large taxpayers, supervised financial or securities entities, entities with annual gross revenue exceeding approximately B/.1,000,000, and entities for which the Panama Maritime Authority requires audited financial statements in connection with the NVOCC license; shareholders may also mandate an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB and adopted in Panama; small and medium-sized entities may apply IFRS for SMEs; books and records must also satisfy the minimum bookkeeping requirements of the Panamanian Fiscal Code.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Panama S.A. must maintain a current register of ultimate beneficial owners at its registered office. Annual good standing is confirmed by payment of the annual franchise tax by 15 March and by the registered agent's annual UBO confirmation. A share transfer resulting in a change of beneficial ownership must be recorded in the Register of Members and reported as a UBO amendment within 30 calendar days of the endorsed transfer.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - 1,200 per year, depending on provider and scope of registered-agent, UBO custody, and document-keeping services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - 10,000 per year for a standard Panama S.A. engaged in NVOCC ocean forwarding, depending on transaction volume and consolidation scope

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays for Sociedades Anonimas; Panama applies a territorial-source regime under which foreign-source ocean freight income is exempt from ISR, while Panama-source NVOCC revenue is taxed at 25% and subsequently subject to 10% dividend withholding upon distribution, producing a combined statutory burden of 32.5% on distributed locally sourced profits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 - Declaracion Anual de Impuesto sobre la Renta (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return), filed electronically through the Sede Electronica of the Autoridad Nacional de Ingresos Publicos (ANIP), www.anip.gob.pa (successor to the DGI e-Tax portal).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, with quarterly advance income-tax payments (pagos directos) due in July, October, January and April for calendar-year taxpayers.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers, ANIP applies a staggered filing calendar by RUC last digit between 15 March and 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1 - Gross Taxable Income (Ingresos Brutos Gravables)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All Panama-source revenues, including NVOCC brokerage commissions, ocean freight billings, container consolidation fees, handling and ancillary charges on cargo originated in or routed through Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners operating through the S.A. must report all income derived from services performed, contracted or paid in Panama; only genuinely foreign-source freight margins supported by contemporaneous documentation qualify for exclusion.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Invoiced operating costs, ocean carrier space charges, subcontracted trucking and port charges, rent, payroll, insurance, agent commissions and other valid ordinary business expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions require valid Panamanian or duly legalized foreign supplier invoices; payments to related offshore entities are deductible only if arm's length and supported by the transfer-pricing documentation file where the related-party threshold is exceeded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 3 - Net Taxable Income (Renta Neta Gravable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 1 minus Line 2, adjusted for non-deductible expenses and prior-year tax loss carryforwards, which are limited to five years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may offset only Panama-source income of the same legal entity and cannot be transferred to or from foreign affiliates or disregarded branch operations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Twenty-five percent of net taxable income, reduced by quarterly advance payments and withholding tax certificates previously credited.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply treaty credits only where a Double Taxation Agreement is in force and a valid Tax Residency Certificate exists; absent treaty relief, pay the full 25% and comply separately with dividend withholding upon profit distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 5 - Tax Credits, Retentions and Prior Payments (Creditos y Retenciones)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Creditable advance payments made during the fiscal year, income tax withheld by clients on local invoices, and any statutory investment or job-creation credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credits are not available for Panama tax purposes; retain all retention certificates issued by Panama-source payers to substantiate credits claimed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a fine of B/.50 to B/.5,000 under the Tax Code, plus a monthly late-payment surcharge of 1.5% on the unpaid tax (capped at 50%) and moratory interest; persistent non-filing authorizes ANIP estimated assessment, suspension of the RUC and criminal tax-evasion prosecution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 750 - Declaracion Informativa de Precios de Transferencia (Transfer Pricing Informative Return), filed through the ANIP Sede Electronica.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Same statutory deadline as Formulario 110, being within three months of fiscal year-end and, for calendar-year taxpayers, the ANIP staggered window from 15 March to 31 March.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section I - Taxpayer and Related-Party Identification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RUC, corporate name, resident agent, and identification of each foreign related counterparty in NVOCC transactions, including ultimate beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the full freight-forwarding group structure and each entity receiving commissions or cost allocations; omission of related parties is treated as a intentional inaccurate filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section II - Related-Party Transactions and Arm's-Length Method
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quantification of intercompany brokerage fees, carrier slot purchases, office cost recharges, interest, royalties and management charges, with the selected transfer-pricing methodology.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM) with the Panamanian NVOCC as the tested party and the operating margin of independent freight forwarders as benchmark; a contemporaneous benchmarking study must be attached where related-party volume equals or exceeds B/.250,000.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Local headcount, office premises, container consolidation capacity, vessel booking activity and local management decisions performed in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile substance indicators with the Annual Economic Substance Report; minimal local operations will trigger audit inquiry and possible re-characterization of the S.A. as a conduit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file or materially incorrect filing of Formulario 750 carries fines up to B/.10,000; upon audit, ANIP may re-price related-party transactions and assess the resulting underpaid ISR with a 20% surcharge, moratory interest and additional penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Informe Anual de Sustancia Economica (Annual Economic Substance Report) under Ley 254 de 2021, filed electronically through ANIP; the tax administration has not assigned a fixed public form number.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 12 months after the end of the relevant fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Designation of the relevant activity or activities, including distribution and service centres, shipping, financing, leasing, holding or headquarters activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An active NVOCC S.A. should declare Distribution and Service Centre; a related ship-owning or chartering entity should declare Shipping; a pure asset-holding affiliate should declare Holding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross relevant income, operating expenditure by category, and the tax residence of each foreign related recipient of distributed profits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Income merely booked in Panama but generated by foreign personnel and foreign management decisions must be disclosed and will trigger an automatic substantive review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of employees in Panama, physical premises, equipment, and total local operating expenditure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Demonstrate a proportionate match between local substance and relevant income booked; a paper-entity profile with no employees or premises is automatically non-compliant.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing of the substance report: fine of USD 10,000; filing of misleading information: USD 100,000; failure to satisfy economic substance requirements: administrative sanctions up to USD 1,000,000, potential loss of tax-residency benefits, and administrative strike-off of the corporate registration.
